Name: Glossy Slimes (CP)
Author: NeonixNeo
Description:
[size=5][b]Glossy Slimes[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]a content patcher mod that re-textures the slimes and slime balls to be glossier and smoother[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]NEW- cat slime and glorp slime vers! input "normal" "cat" "glorp" or "melt" in the .config file
NEW NEW- monster variety version with a config for more stupid looking slimes![/b][/size]

[size=4]credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece]siamece[/url] for the header style[/size]



[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url] 
you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32241]monster variety[/url] for the alt version[/size][/color]



[size=4]Thank you to anyone who's supported my stardew mods by downloading or updating them. you're all very precious to me![/size]
